text:
maya: Quick sync — I sketched a 'Starter' micro-tier to drive SMB/onramp customers. Wanted to get alignment on launch constraints and what we can/should promise.

sam: +1 — sales asked for a low-friction offering. Key asks: predictable monthly bill, small commit option, and an easy upgrade path.

chris: Important to call out finance constraints: anything < $500 MRR needs automated guardrails (no manual invoicing) and a hard cap on reserved capacity exposure.

maya: Proposed shape: $49/mo, 200k free tokens included, metered overage at $0.0008/token, opt-in monthly commit up to $500/mo (auto-renew), no SLA, self-serve cancellation.

lee: Legal: keep it simple. No enterprise T&Cs. We need an acceptance of standard ToS and an explicit limitation of liability for usage. Also clarify data retention and deletion flow.

toni: From eng: two things — (1) we need a lightweight tenant isolation flag for Starter so customers don't accidentally get routed to Dedicated GPUs, (2) quota enforcement must be strictly enforced at API gateway. Both are small but need a week of work.

devon: Ops: want to avoid small noisy tenants hitting routing. Suggest default rate limit 20 rps, burst 50, and a CPU-only fallback plan if GPU pool is full.

maya: Agree on rate limits. Also thinking about auto-throttle messages to customers when nearing quota with a 3-tier email cadence.

sam: Sales: two product asks — (A) promo code support for first 3 months, (B) a single-click upgrade to 'Growth' tier that preserves usage history. Are both doable?

toni: Promo codes are a billing + checkout integration — front-end + billing API. We can do a minimal version (percentage off + expiry) in ~2 sprints if prioritized. Upgrade flow is straightforward if we maintain customer_id mapping.

chris: Billing: promo codes are fine but they complicate revenue recognition a bit; we need metadata on promo usage. Also we need to limit promo creation to finance + sales admin roles.

lee: Legal flags promo terms — must not promise refunds outside ToS. Also any automatic upgrade path needs opt-out confirmation.

maya: Launch gating checklist proposal (must-haves): engineering isolation flag + quota enforcement, billing promo basics, checkout flow, simple docs + FAQs, monitoring alert for unusual usage, and a one-week beta with support on-call.

devon: Ops gating: add alert for >5x baseline token/sec for any Starter tenant, and a circuit-tripper that moves requests to the CPU fallback with a header x-fallback:starter.

toni: Implementation note: isolation flag will be a tenant-level boolean. Quota enforcement lives in api-gw; i'll drop a short spec later.

maya: Spec request: can you add the API snippet we expect customers to call for sign-up + billing? Need to include promo param.

toni: posted short snippet in thread: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/signup \n-H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \n-d '{"plan":"starter","promo_code":"SPRING24","team_name":"Acme"}'```

sam: Can we allow free trials? Sales says yes if it's self-serve 7-day trial with card required.

chris: Card required for trial increases conversion, but we must flag failed payments and not extend trials. Also set max trial per email to prevent abuse.

lee: Privacy: collect minimal PII. For trial we can require name/email and card last4 only stored in billing provider — ok.

maya: Outstanding decision: soft launch to 100 accounts vs open. My vote: soft launch to control noise. Thoughts?

sam: Soft launch makes sense. Sales wants an initial batch of 50 partners so we can iterate on onboarding flow.

chris: Finance wants a clear sunset path — if Starter generates > $10k MRR in 90 days, we revisit reserve exposure and SLA/ops commitments.

devon: Ops: agree. Also require an automated daily report of top 10 Starter tenants by token/sec.

maya: Ok locking decisions for MVP: pricing as proposed, no SLA, quota/rate limits enforced, simple promo support, self-serve 7-day trial (card required), soft launch to 50-100 accounts, isolation flag, CPU fallback.

lee: I'll add short legal copy for the checkout and promo T&Cs.

toni: I'll drop a tech spec PR tomorrow with timelines (ETA: 2 sprints for core infra + 1 sprint for promo + docs).

chris: I'll prepare finance guardrail sheet and assign limits for automated approvals.

maya: Thanks all — i'll convert this into a launch spec doc and share the doc link here when done. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: New doc created: /docs/product/starter-microtier-launch-spec (editable by product & eng).
